k1.author: seed
k1.text: Call svc.apply(app) with the application dict; it returns a dict.

k3.author: seed
k3.text: handle(app, svc) returns {action, limit}; action `issue` uses the returned limit, action `decline` has limit 0.

k5.author: worker-B
k5.quote: For every partner in the network, whatever the partner decided, an application from a self_employed applicant whose requested_limit is above 6000 must be placed in manual review (queue_review) instead of being issued. A decline stays a decline.
k5.text: Network rule: for any partner, a self_employed applicant with requested_limit above 6000 must be placed in queue_review instead of being issued; a decline stays a decline.

k6.author: worker-B
k6.quote: Application fields: id, age, income, employment (employed or self_employed), requested_limit.
k6.text: Brightmoor application dict fields: id, age, income, employment (employed or self_employed), requested_limit.

k7.author: worker-B
k7.quote: svc.apply now returns {"api_version": 2, "result": {"outcome": "approved" | "declined" | "manual_review", "credit_limit": <int>}}. The v1 fields `decision` and `limit` are removed.
k7.text: API v2 (current): svc.apply returns {"api_version":2, "result":{"outcome":"approved"|"declined"|"manual_review","credit_limit":<int>}}. v1 fields `decision` and `limit` are removed.

k8.author: worker-B
k8.quote: outcome manual_review replaces refer and is handled as in spec section 3.
k8.text: Outcome mapping: approved->issue (use credit_limit), declined->decline (limit 0), manual_review->queue_review (limit 0).
